create_autotrain_dataset_for_text_classi: create an AutoTrainDataset instance to prepare text binary or multi class classification data from CSV files
prepare_image_classification_dataset: prepare an AutoTrainImageClassificationDataset from a zip file or local folder for image multi class classification
build_tabular_regression_dataset: build an AutoTrainDataset for tabular single or multi column regression tasks using CSV training data
create_vlm_dataset: create an AutoTrainVLMDataset with column mapping to prepare vision language model training data from zip or local paths
remove_non_image_files_from_folder: remove all non image files from a folder recursively keeping only jpg jpeg png and jsonl files
